title: Neon Pulse — Episode 20: Vance Revealed
description: Kael confronts Commander Vance at the upper level facility, uncovering the devastating truth behind the amber circuitry syndicate.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: Bursting through the emergency hatch, I emerged onto the windy upper platform as alarms wailed below.
scenes.visual: steaming industrial hatch opening wide on a rain slicked metal rooftop against a dark stormy sky low angle action shot cinematic lighting no text

scenes.narration: Commander Vance stood waiting by the extraction chopper, bathed in the red glare of warning lights.
scenes.visual: silver haired military commander standing beside a idling helicopter on a rooftop platform glowing red warning beacons casting harsh shadows no text

scenes.narration: My jacket surged with blinding amber light as the pulse matched the volatile energy signature in the air.
scenes.visual: close up on glowing amber circuitry lines flaring brightly across dark fabric while sparks crackle in the damp night air dynamic camera angle no text

scenes.narration: You cannot stop what has already been initiated, Vance shouted over the rising turbine roar.
scenes.visual: mature commander shouting angrily with hand raised in command stance against spinning helicopter blades wind whipping his uniform no text

scenes.narration: I fired a concentrated pulse of energy straight at the control console, shorting out the launch sequence.
scenes.visual: bright beam of amber light striking a metal control panel sending cascading blue sparks and smoke flying toward the camera no text

scenes.narration: The explosion threw us both backward, shattering the glass walkway into a cascade of sparkling debris.
scenes.visual: shockwave blast blowing apart a glass bridge into thousands of floating shards with silhouetted figures tumbling backward slow motion no text

scenes.narration: As Vance dragged himself toward the departing aircraft, he dropped a data drive bearing the syndicate symbol.
scenes.visual: metallic data drive falling through the air toward wet grating with glowing embers drifting downward dramatic side profile close up no text

scenes.narration: I gripped the drive as the chopper vanished into the clouds, knowing the real war had just begun.
scenes.visual: determined hero clenching a small glowing data drive tightly in his fist while watching a distant aircraft disappear into heavy storm clouds no text

scenes.narration: Follow along for more chapters of the original hero saga every single week.
